rounds.title: Aptitude & Logical Reasoning
rounds.description: Solve progressive multiple-choice questions assessing quantitative ability, series, logical reasoning, and permutations.

rounds.title: AI Group Discussion
rounds.description: Voice-enabled interactive topic discussion. Present clear articulation, structured thoughts, pros/cons, and persuasive conclusions.

rounds.title: Technical & Coding Round
rounds.description: Real-time coding challenges covering basic programming, data structures (Search, Arrays, Stacks), and object-oriented fundamentals.

rounds.title: HR & Behavioral Round
rounds.description: Voice-driven HR behavioral assessment. Evaluate candidate cultural fit, conflict resolution, work ethic, and situational maturity.

securityGuidelines.title: Tab Switching
securityGuidelines.detail: Switching tabs or windows during an active test will be flagged.

securityGuidelines.title: Shortcuts & Inspection
securityGuidelines.detail: Right-click and dev-tool keys are disabled inside assessment rounds.

securityGuidelines.title: Single Continuous Session
securityGuidelines.detail: Complete all 4 rounds in sequence for the overall composite rating.

securityGuidelines.title: Adaptive Scoring
securityGuidelines.detail: Each round holds 100 marks (400 total) with weighted evaluation.

securityGuidelines.title: Set Anti-Repetition
securityGuidelines.detail: Your next interview attempt will automatically cycle to a fresh non-repeating set.

securityGuidelines.title: Final Performance Report
securityGuidelines.detail: An analytics card with individual round breakdowns is generated at the end.
